messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Re: Error: annotate.WithGenicParts, Annotation Problem
parts:
It is hard to say what it could be. It may be have something to do with file formats. Please send a minimal example set that reproduces the problem. What you need to do is to subset myDiffCpG.all to make it smaller but still reproducing the problem.
save the resulting object and "gene.obj" as RData file and send it to me.

you can do something along the lines of:
save(subset.myDiffCpG.all, gene.obj,file="myData.RData")

and for session info: you just copy paste the output of sessionInfo() command.
See the link below to get an idea about how to make a reproducible example.
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/5963269/how-to-make-a-great-r-reproducible-example

Best,
Altuna
